segments.contextAfter: **Memory**: Memory insights provide recommendations to reduce the amount of GPU memory that your workload uses. By default, Xcode sorts the recommendations by the amount of memory saved, so you can focus on the biggest potential wins first. In the following example, setting the wrong storage mode results in an additional 10.2 MB of GPU memory usage. The developer of this app can save that memory by following the advice and switching to memoryless.
